extracted.intended_audience: credentialed sports media, beat writers, and broadcast partners covering NBA teams
extracted.subtask_description: Operational guidelines and contact directory for media covering NBA teams, including credential pickup, media entrance/parking, directions, and PR contacts. Includes lists of beat writers, broadcasters, and wire-service/media partner contacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ticket will call / will call pickup location
rubrics_metrics.description: Tickets can be picked up at Gate 4, which is inside the East Atrium. (United Center) / WILL CALL WINDOW: Corner of Huron Road and Ontario Street inside the Sherwin-Williams Entrance. (Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide lists the specific will-call locations for venues (examples include Gate 4 inside the East Atrium at United Center and the Corner of Huron Road and Ontario Street inside the Sherwin-Williams Entrance at Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse). Media should use the venue-specific will call window noted for that team/arena.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media entrance location
rubrics_metrics.description: MEDIA ENTRANCE: Media may enter the United Center through Gate 3-1/2 on the northeast corner of the building. / MEDIA ENTRANCE: East side of Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse (across from Gateway East Plaza and to the left of the Cavaliers Team Shop). / MEDIA ENTRANCE: Located in the loading dock of the arena. (Ball Arena) / MEDIA ENTRANCE/WILL CALL PICKUP: Located on the southwest entrance of the arena. (American Airlines Center)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the specified media entrance for credentialed access. The guide provides per-arena entrance points; follow the venue-specific instruction (gate number, side of building, loading dock, or southwest entrance) when arriving.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media parking — designated lots and locations
rubrics_metrics.description: All credentialed media may park in Lot A located on Washington Blvd. (United Center). / MEDIA PARKING: Toyota Tacoma Lot, near Chopper Circle entrance, off Speer and Wewatta. (Ball Arena) / MEDIA PARKING: In Lexus Garage on the corner of N Houston St. and All-Star Way, with parking pass or on list. (American Airlines Center)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide lists the designated media parking lots by venue. Media should park only in the designated media lots (Lot A, Lexus Garage, Toyota Tacoma Lot, etc.) and follow venue-specific directions to those lots.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media parking reservation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Parking must be reserved in advance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where stated (e.g., United Center entry: 'Parking must be reserved in advance.'), credentialed media are required to reserve parking ahead of arrival. Confirm reservation process with the team's communications office if not specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credential/ticket pickup procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Credential pickup is inside doors / Credential pickup is inside doors. (Media Entrance/Will Call pickup notes) / Credential pickup is inside doors at the southwest entrance (American Airlines Center). / Courtside and team communications phone numbers provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Credentials and tickets are typically picked up at the venue's media entrance or will call window; follow the venue-specific pickup location. If in doubt, contact the team's basketball communications office (phone/email provided) for instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Directions and driving instructions from airports / major routes
rubrics_metrics.description: UNITED CENTER/ADVOCATE CENTER (From O’Hare): Take 90/94 East (Kennedy Expressway) to the Madison Street exit... (full turn-by-turn). (From Midway): Take 55 North to 90 West. Exit at Madison Street... / ROCKET MORTGAGE FIELDHOUSE (from Cleveland Hopkins Airport): I-71 North to Ontario St. exit (or E. 9th St. exit)... / AMERICAN AIRLINES CENTER (From DFW Airport): Take the airport’s south exit to 183 East ...183 East to I-35 South ... Exit to Oak Lawn/Victory Ave./Hi Line ... (From Love Field): Same as above but follow directions from I-35 South. / BALL ARENA: (From Denver International Airport) Take I-70 West to I-25 South, take to Speer Blvd. exit and turn left at stop light. Ball Arena will be on right. Enter at Chopper Circle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Venue-specific driving directions are provided for media arriving from local airports and major highways; follow the turn-by-turn guidance for the arena you are attending. Keep venue address handy for GPS navigation (addresses are listed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Practice facility and secondary venue directions / addresses
rubrics_metrics.description: Advocate Center (Team Practice Facility): (312) 455-4300; Advocate Center is located at 15 S. Wood Street (across the street from the arena), at the corner of Wood Street and Madison Street. / CLEVELAND CLINIC COURTS, 6101 Brecksville Road, Independence, OH 44131 (detailed directions provided). / Practice Facility: 1530 Inspiration Dr., Suite 300, Dallas, TX 75207 (Mavericks)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide provides specific addresses and directions for practice facilities and secondary venues; media should use these directions when covering practice sessions or visiting team facilities separate from the main arena.

rubrics_metrics.name: Team basketball communications and PR contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists names, titles, office and cell numbers, and emails for team PR/media relations staff (examples: Andre Toran, Senior Coordinator of Basketball Communications, C-(757) 705-3226, atoran@bulls.com; B.J. Evans, Vice President, Basketball Communications, O-(216) 420-2464 C-(216) 644-7765 bevans@cavs.com; Victoria Martinez, Vice President, Basketball Communications, C-(469) 613-9697 victoria.martinez@dallasmavs.com).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the listed communications staff as primary contacts for credentialing, media questions, interview requests, and logistics. Contact details include office and cell phones and email addresses; reach out to the appropriate PR contact for the team you are covering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lists of writers, beat reporters, editors, and media partner contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: WRITERS REGULARLY ASSIGNED TO CLUB — extensive lists of beat writers and their contact info and social handles (examples: Sam Smith, Bulls.com; K.C. Johnson, Chicago Sports Network; Chris Fedor, Cleveland.com; Mike Curtis, Dallas Morning News). / SPORTS EDITORS, WRITERS, AND COLUMNISTS and TEAM BROADCASTERS, RADIO BROADCASTERS, TELEVISION BROADCASTERS sections list outlets, editors, reporters, producers, and contact numbers/emails.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide functions as a directory of local and national media regularly covering each club. Media can use these contacts for networking, verifying coverage, or coordinating interviews. Entries include phone numbers, emails, and X (Twitter) handles where provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wire service and media partner contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: WIRE SERVICE entries list Associated Press and other wire contacts and phone numbers (example: ASSOCIATED PRESS, 55 E. Monroe St., 31st Floor, Chicago, IL 60603, (312) 920-3620; Reporter: Andy Seligman). / Other partners (Reuters, Bally Sports, Altitude, ESPN bureaus) are similarly listed with contacts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wire services and broadcast partners are listed with specific contact persons. Use these contacts for coordinating wire coverage, photos, or broadcast access; note which outlets are flagship broadcasters or regional partners for each team.
